name: wow-launcher
description: 河狸乐园WLK怀旧服 - 综合登录器

scripts.electron:dev: concurrently "vite" "wait-on http://localhost:1420 && cross-env ELECTRON_DEV=1 ELECTRON_DEV_SERVER_IP=127.0.0.1 electron electron/main.cjs"
scripts.electron:dev:prod: concurrently "vite" "wait-on http://localhost:1420 && cross-env ELECTRON_DEV=1 ELECTRON_DEV_SERVER_IP=117.72.202.12 electron electron/main.cjs"
scripts.electron:build: vue-tsc -b && vite build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false ELECTRON_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron/ ELECTRON_BUILDER_BINARIES_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron-builder-binaries/ electron-builder
scripts.electron:build:win: vue-tsc -b && vite build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false ELECTRON_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron/ ELECTRON_BUILDER_BINARIES_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron-builder-binaries/ electron-builder --win --x64 --ia32
scripts.electron:asar-build: vue-tsc -b && vite build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false ELECTRON_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron/ ELECTRON_BUILDER_BINARIES_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron-builder-binaries/ electron-builder --win --x64 --ia32 && node scripts/pack-asar.cjs
